1 """campaign_parts — resolve a roadmap step's ``ref`` against the record it points at.
2 
3 W0b of the High Seat plan (2026-09-26). A Campaign part is a step whose ``ref`` names
4 another record: ``project:<pid>`` · ``step:<pid>/<sid>`` · ``deliverable:<pid>/<row>`` ·
5 ``calendar:<id>``. The Campaign never copies or writes the target's date or state; this
6 module READS them, once per distinct target per request (the ``cache`` dict the caller
7 passes), and names a broken reference instead of inventing anything.
8 
9 Pure apart from file reads; never raises on odd input; no model, no bridge spawn.
10 """
11 from __future__ import annotations
12 
13 import json
14 from pathlib import Path
15 from urllib.parse import unquote
16 
17 REF_KINDS = ("project", "step", "deliverable", "calendar", "effort")   # effort:<pid>/<dir> — one cockpit within a project (2026-09-30)
18 _OPEN = ("proposed", "planned", "active", "waiting")
19 
20 
21 def parse_ref(ref):
22     """``'step:abc/lec3'`` → ``{"kind","pid","sub"}``; None when malformed."""
23     s = str(ref or "").strip()
24     if ":" not in s:
25         return None
26     kind, rest = s.split(":", 1)
27     rest = rest.strip()
28     if kind not in REF_KINDS or not rest or any(ch.isspace() for ch in rest):
29         return None
30     if kind in ("step", "deliverable", "effort"):
31         if "/" not in rest:
32             return None
33         pid, sub = rest.split("/", 1)
34         if not pid or not sub:
35             return None
36         if kind == "effort":
37             # Stored refs have no literal whitespace; effort folders commonly do.
38             # Decode once, then let resolve_ref enforce the one-directory boundary.
39             try:
40                 sub = unquote(sub, errors="strict")
41             except UnicodeError:
42                 return None
43         return {"kind": kind, "pid": pid, "sub": sub}
44     if kind == "calendar":
45         return {"kind": kind, "pid": "", "sub": rest}
46     return {"kind": kind, "pid": rest, "sub": ""}

49 def _default_lookup(pid):
50     """The registry entry for the full id, nothing looser (a prefix would bind whichever project has it)."""
51     try:
52         import rnd_registry as _rnd
53         return _rnd.get_project(pid) or None
54     except Exception:
55         return None

58 def _cached(cache, key, fn):
59     if key in cache:
60         return cache[key]
61     try:
62         v = fn()
63     except Exception:
64         v = None
65     cache[key] = v
66     return v

97 def _nearest_due(steps):
98     dues = sorted(str(s.get("due")) for s in steps or ()
99                   if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("due") and s.get("status") in _OPEN)
100     return dues[0] if dues else ""

103 def resolve_ref(ref, cache=None, lookup=None, with_lead=False):
104     """One part → ``{"ref","kind","pid","name","what","state","date","href","lead","broken","gap"}``."""
105     cache = cache if isinstance(cache, dict) else {}
106     lookup = lookup or _default_lookup
107     out = {"ref": str(ref or ""), "kind": "", "pid": "", "name": "", "what": "", "state": "",
108            "date": "", "href": "", "lead": "", "broken": True, "gap": ""}
109     p = parse_ref(ref)
110     if not p:
111         out["gap"] = "not a reference the Campaign knows (project: · step: · deliverable: · calendar: · effort:)"
112         return out
113     out["kind"] = p["kind"]
114     if p["kind"] == "calendar":
115         out["gap"] = "calendar not connected"
116         return out
117     entry = _cached(cache, ("entry", p["pid"]), lambda: lookup(p["pid"]))
118     if not entry or not entry.get("folder_path"):
119         out["pid"] = p["pid"]
120         out["gap"] = "no project with id %s" % p["pid"]
121         return out
122     folder = entry["folder_path"]
123     out["pid"] = str(entry.get("id") or p["pid"])
124     out["name"] = str(entry.get("name") or out["pid"][:8])
125     steps = _projection(folder, cache)
126     if p["kind"] == "project":
127         out["href"] = "/project/%s" % out["pid"]
128         # the same fact the home's rows use: the strip's human wait, else the last status's "waiting on you"
129         wait = _strip_wait(folder, cache)
130         if not wait:
131             plan = _summary(folder, cache).get("plan")
132             wait = " ".join(str((plan or {}).get("waiting_on_you") or "").split()) if isinstance(plan, dict) else ""
133             wait = (wait[:88].rstrip() + "…") if len(wait) > 90 else wait
134         out["state"] = ("waiting on you: " + wait) if wait else ""
135         out["date"] = _nearest_due(steps)
136         out["broken"] = False
137     elif p["kind"] == "effort":
138         # one cockpit within the project (2026-09-30): the effort directory with its own Face; its light is the
139         # ONE attention flag the steward writes; its date the nearest due of its own roadmap
140         from pathlib import Path as _P
141         from urllib.parse import quote as _q
142         eff = _P(folder) / p["sub"]
143         sub_ = str(p["sub"])
144         try:
145             inside = eff.resolve().parent == _P(folder).resolve()
146         except OSError:
147             inside = False
148         if sub_ in (".", "..") or "\\" in sub_ or "/" in sub_ or not inside:
149             out["gap"] = "an effort is one directory inside %s, not '%s'" % (out["name"], sub_)      # Grok's read of W2b: never a path out of the project
150             return out
151         if not (eff / "ECGBERHT.md").is_file():
152             out["gap"] = "no effort '%s' in %s" % (p["sub"], out["name"])
153             return out
154         title = p["sub"]
155         try:
156             for ln in (eff / "ECGBERHT.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()[:40]:
157                 if ln.startswith("# "):
158                     heading = ln[2:].strip()
159                     if heading and not heading.lower().startswith("ecgberht"):
160                         title = heading
161                     break
162         except OSError:
163             pass
164         out["what"] = title
165         out["dir"] = sub_
166         out["name"] = "%s · %s" % (out["name"], title)
167         out["href"] = "/project/%s?dir=%s" % (out["pid"], _q(p["sub"]))
168         try:
169             import json as _json
170             att = _json.loads((eff / ".ecgberht" / "attention.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
171         except Exception:
172             att = {}
173         state = str((att or {}).get("state") or "").lower() if isinstance(att, dict) else ""
174         reason = " ".join(str((att or {}).get("reason") or "").split()) if isinstance(att, dict) else ""
175         reason = (reason[:88].rstrip() + "…") if len(reason) > 90 else reason
176         out["state"] = ("waiting on you: " + reason) if state == "needs_you" else ((state.replace("_", " ") + ((": " + reason) if reason else "")) if state else "")
177         out["date"] = _nearest_due(_projection(str(eff), cache))
178         out["broken"] = False
179     elif p["kind"] == "step":
180         st = next((s for s in steps or () if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("id") == p["sub"]), None)
181         if st is None:
182             out["gap"] = ("no step '%s' in %s" % (p["sub"], out["name"])) if steps is not None \
183                 else ("%s has no readable plan" % out["name"])
184             return out
185         out["href"] = "/project/%s" % out["pid"]
186         out["what"] = str(st.get("name") or p["sub"])
187         out["state"] = str(st.get("status") or "")
188         # W1 (2026-09-28): the TARGET's own status, typed, so the Campaign's open/next reads the referenced step's
189         # truth and never the wrapper's status alone (Grok's live replay: a done target stayed "next")
190         out["target_status"] = str(st.get("status") or "")
191         if st.get("waiting_on") and st.get("status") in ("waiting", "parked"):
192             out["state"] += " · " + str(st.get("waiting_on"))
193         out["date"] = str(st.get("due") or "")
194         out["broken"] = False
195     elif p["kind"] == "deliverable":
196         items = _register(folder, cache)
197         if not p["sub"].isdigit():
198             out["gap"] = "a deliverable part names a row number (deliverable:<pid>/<n>); '%s' is not one" % p["sub"]
199             return out
200         n = int(p["sub"])
201         it = items[n - 1] if 1 <= n <= len(items) else None
202         if it is None:
203             out["gap"] = "no row %d in %s's register (%d rows)" % (n, out["name"], len(items))
204             return out
205         out["what"] = str(it.get("what") or "")
206         out["href"] = str(it.get("route") or "") or "/project/%s" % out["pid"]
207         out["state"] = "current" if it.get("is_current") else ""
208         out["broken"] = False
209     if with_lead and not out["broken"]:
210         out["lead"] = str(_summary(folder, cache).get("lead_line") or "")
211     return out

214 def resolve_parts(steps, cache=None, lookup=None, with_lead=False):
215     """Every step carrying ``ref`` → ``{step_id: resolved}``. Steps without ``ref`` are skipped."""
216     cache = cache if isinstance(cache, dict) else {}
217     out = {}
218     for s in steps or ():
219         try:
220             if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("ref") and s.get("id"):
221                 out[str(s["id"])] = resolve_ref(s["ref"], cache=cache, lookup=lookup, with_lead=with_lead)
222         except Exception:
223             continue
224     return out
